termination: Actual and imagined fall at root height <0.35m or upright Z<0.5. Reference end is finite-task terminal with zero tail; score terminal-step reward once. Model fall mask is hard and not differentiated.
common_prior: One identical pre-supervision zero-output checkpoint for all methods and training seeds. It includes previously fitted balance slopes, static kinematics and normalization from reference-source observations; no claim of training from scratch or a prior-free mocap method. Independently seeded collection/optimization defines the three new training runs.
data_access: Reference motion poses/velocities and reset snapshots are commands/setup. Source controls are not actor targets or dynamics labels. No prior reference policy evaluation or source transitions train these learners. Dynamics and critics fit only newly collected on-policy physical records. First noisy collection is shared per seed, charged to each standalone algorithm and recorded once. Three extra zero-policy noise realizations per seed are model diagnostics only and never fitted.
critic: Same zero-initialized architecture and common-data normalization. Physical finite-task GAE for PPO advantages; critic fits Monte Carlo physical returns for both methods. Input includes privileged physical state relative to current reference root position, H10 actual observations, both causal EMA velocities, current reference, context, reference ID and phase/remaining time. MBRL differentiates through this physical-return critic at H32. This is not the paper's imagined-GAE critic recipe.
actor_objective: Mean discounted finite-task return from this cycle's nine physical reset states. MBRL samples only those episode starts, carrying exact controller history/EMA state. PPO uses gamma^(time since reset) visitation weights and pre-fit GAE advantages divided by their standard deviation without centering. Physical exploration is the same fixed latent Gaussian for both; MBRL imagination uses the deterministic mean, and final qualification evaluates deterministic means for both.
budget_and_selection: Nine physical training episodes per cycle, equal maximum actor steps, model-specific fitting/imagination charged separately; PPO may stop early on KL. All three final-cycle checkpoints are evaluated on the unchanged 27-cell quality suite; no seed/checkpoint selection or threshold changes. Shared deterministic initial evaluation runs once. No intermediate quality checks: cost-to-target can only be bounded by the initial/final checks, not claimed as an exact first crossing.
costs: Keep common reference/teacher/feedback/supervised-baseline development separate; report fresh collection, model diagnostic collection, model/critic/actor optimization, final evaluation and serialization. Sequential local CPU measurements, not GPU-hour equivalence. A quality-failing method has no successful cost-to-target.
scope: Bounded matched full-reference learning comparison, not full phase acceptance, unseen-motion coverage, production restart support, hardware qualification or a predeclared model-based speedup.
